about:
FabricSpan operates from Idaho Falls, Idaho, as a contract manufacturer specializing in fabric membrane structures for architectural, commercial, and industrial applications. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The shop provides end-to-end fabrication services including design and pattern development, material procurement, CNC cutting, RF welding, hot air welding, and industrial sewing. Its product range covers frame and tent structures, air-inflated structures, tensile and shade structures, facades, covers, liners, and air-supported structures. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

FabricSpan works with contractors, engineers, designers, architects, building owners, other manufacturers, and fabric suppliers. Notable projects include designing and manufacturing dual membrane roofs for a biomass anaerobic digester operated by Waste No Energy in Monticello, Indiana, and a custom tensioned-membrane building for Monticello Montessori. The company also serves the broader architectural, commercial, industrial, waste-management, and education sectors.

The company states that confidentiality is an essential part of its service, pledging to protect customers’ product development and project information. It emphasizes quality service and professionalism aimed at meeting customer expectations, though it does not articulate a specific founding mission beyond helping partners bring project ideas to life.
